19 ORDER
20 On March 8, 2023, LUBA granted a joint motion to suspend the appeal.
21 No further communication from the parties has been received regarding the status
22 of this appeal since the date of that order.
23 Not later than July 25, 2023, the parties shall advise LUBA whether this
24 appeal should be dismissed or reactivated. If either party advises us that they wish
25 to continue the suspension, or we do not receive a response to this Order, we will
26 issue an Order continuing the suspension for an additional 14 days. At the
27 conclusion of that 14-day extension, this appeal will be dismissed without further
28 notice, unless one or more parties request that the appeal be reactivated.
